intro:
The USA offers an exceptional range of top-ranked universities, world-leading research opportunities and flexible curricula that allow students to explore different majors. It remains a leading choice for Indian students pursuing STEM, business and research-intensive postgraduate programmes.

A degree from a recognised US university can open up career opportunities across different countries and industries, making the USA a popular study-abroad destination for international students.
why: Largest choice of universities and program specialisations available
Assistantships, fellowships and merit scholarships options
STEM graduates get up to 3 years of OPT work authorisation
Strong campus research and industry linkage
visa: To study in the USA, you'll need an F-1 Student Visa. Requirements: Admission letter (I-20 form) from the university, SEVIS fee payment, proof of financials, proof of English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and a visa interview at the consulate.
intakes: Fall (August–September) is the main intake with the widest course and funding choice. Spring (January) is smaller. Start 10–12 months ahead for GRE/GMAT, TOEFL/IELTS and applications.

req.label: Academics
req.value: 65%+ in bachelor's (16 years of education preferred for master's)

req.label: Aptitude test
req.value: GRE for STEM, GMAT for MBA (waivers available)

req.label: Documents
req.value: Marksheets, Resume, SOP, 2 LORs, Transcripts, passport

sch.name: University merit scholarships
sch.text: Partial to full tuition waivers based on academics and test scores

sch.name: Graduate assistantships
sch.text: Teaching or research roles covering tuition plus a stipend

sch.name: External scholarships
sch.text: Fulbright-Nehru, Inlaks, Tata Scholarships for Indian students

steps.title: Receive I-20
steps.text: University issues your I-20 after admission and financial documents

steps.title: Pay SEVIS fee
steps.text: Pay I-901 SEVIS fee and keep the receipt

steps.title: Fill DS-160
steps.text: Complete the online visa form and pay the MRV fee

steps.title: Book appointments
steps.text: Biometrics (VAC) followed by the consular interview

steps.title: Interview
steps.text: Answer questions on course, funding and post-study plans

work: You may work 20 hours a week on campus during terms and full time on vacations. After graduation, OPT gives 12 months of work authorisation, extended to 36 months for STEM degrees.

faq.q: Is GRE mandatory for the USA?
faq.a: Many universities have made GRE optional, but a good score still strengthens funding chances for STEM programmes.

faq.q: How much proof of funds is needed?
faq.a: Typically one year of tuition plus living costs as shown on your I-20.
Yes, on an F-2 dependent visa, though F-2 holders cannot work.

faq.q: What is the visa success rate with Trinity?
faq.a: Our counsellors screen documents and run mock interviews, which is where most refusals are prevented.
